notes: Whitelist of routine targets Auggie can schedule for the buyer.
v1: ~12 specific known MCP/back-end actions. Each entry is one action one staff member does on a schedule.
Phase 2 opens arbitrary intent (Auggie figures out unwhitelisted targets).
key (string) — canonical id used in routine.target
staff (string) — staff member's shortName for floor-render attribution
label (string) — human display label for the routine in the Studio Routines tab
description (string) — single-sentence explanation for Auggie's confirmation reply
endpoint (string) — relative URL of the Netlify function the tick fires
method ('GET' | 'POST') — HTTP method for the fire
default_params (object) — params merged into the body on each fire
param_schema (object) — what the user can override per routine instance
example_cron (string) — example 5-field cron Auggie offers as default
example_human (string) — same schedule in human English ET

targets.label: Jax · SEO scan + auto-apply
targets.description: Jax scans your site for SEO opportunities, drafts safe fixes, and pushes the safe-auto-apply ones live to main.

targets.label: Jax · SEO scan + report only
targets.description: Jax scans your site for SEO opportunities and files a report. No auto-apply; you review and approve before any push.

targets.label: Imani · Newswire daily filing
targets.description: Imani files the day's Newswire piece across her desk. Picks up trending stories from the live web.

targets.label: Imani · weekly desk briefing
targets.description: Imani files a weekly briefing for a specific Newswire desk (tech, business, peace, etc.). Trend rollup plus quotes.

targets.label: Auggie · daily morning brief
targets.description: Auggie scans the live web for mentions of you and your fields overnight and files your morning brief.

targets.label: Margaret · Daily Dose generation
targets.description: Margaret hosts today's Dose episode with the cast. Generates audio plus the written companion.

targets.label: Eli · claim-check sweep on Dose drafts
targets.description: Eli sweeps the day's Daily Dose draft, flags any health claims that need a citation, pulls receipts from PubMed and DSLD.

targets.label: Henry · ClinicalTrials.gov sweep
targets.description: Henry sweeps ClinicalTrials.gov for new trials matching your topic and files an update.

targets.label: Imani · scheduled Press Hub publish
targets.description: Imani publishes the queued Press Hub piece for you. Pulls from the queue, drops it to the live wire.

targets.label: Jess · GP publicity sweep
targets.description: Jess files the week's GP publicity rollup. Tracks placements, flags follow-ups, drafts a thank-you list.

targets.label: Eli · Stoplight evidence refresh
targets.description: Eli refreshes Stoplight's evidence on a list of supplements / ingredients. Pulls latest PubMed, DSLD, OpenFDA.

targets.label: Auggie · regenerate staff Watercooler topics
targets.description: Auggie regenerates the per-staff Watercooler topic pool for the week so The Floor sounds fresh.
